title: Paṭipadā
text: 1.2. Sāvatthi || || Tatravoca || || 3. Micchāpaṭipadañca vo bhikkhave desissāmi sammāpaṭipadañca || taṃ suṇātha || || 4. Katamā ca bhikkhave micchāpaṭipadā || || Seyyathīdaṃ || micchādiṭṭhi || pa [pe] || micchāsamādhi || || Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave micchāpaṭipadā || || 5. Katamā ca bhikkhave sammāpaṭipadā || || Seyyathīdam || sammādiṭṭhi || pa [pe] || sammāsamādhi || || Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sammāpaṭipadā ti || ||
